verdict.rationale: The installer writes the skills into your repo as ordinary, editable files you own. Nothing updates behind your back, and you pull upstream changes explicitly with `npx skills update`. A hands-on probe confirmed a copy install into ./.claude/skills/. This means versioning, review and rollback are possible only implicitly, through your own git workflow; the plugin install route instead self-updates as a read-only bundle. missing for 10: built-in versioning or pinning of skill releases, any documented review flow for changes to the automations themselves, an explicit rollback mechanism, independent corroboration.
